offering_description.value: Operates a casino and sportsbook for patrons in Dodge City, Kansas, under a state gaming management contract. Designs and manufactures aircraft electronics and modification equipment, and engineers and installs upgrades for commercial, private and government aircraft operators.

primary_services.value: Casino management and gaming operations; sportsbook operations; aircraft modification engineering and installation; aircraft maintenance
